brief:
Two URNs are lexically equivalent if they are octet-by-octet equal
   after the following preprocessing:

           1. normalize the case of the leading "urn:" token
           2. normalize the case of the NID
           3. normalizing the case of any %-escaping

   Note that %-escaping MUST NOT be removed.
strong:
Rules for Lexical Equivalence:

         The namespace-specific part of the URN is case-sensitive.
weak:
Rules for Lexical Equivalence:

         The entire URN is case-sensitive.
held_constant: The heading and sentence; only the scope phrase differs.
notes: The published registration says the entire URN is case-sensitive; the brief normalizes the case of 'urn:' and the namespace id.
